scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,blue "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:java: concurrently -n API,WEB -c green,blue "cd backend-java && mvn spring-boot:run" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w web
